sentences.text: Month four of the salinity-probe calibration debate, the secretary noted wearily in the minutes. Contractor briefers love the phrase "mature technology," but the armor package they pitched has never survived a live-fire test. Half the room wanted Ellen's supplier's name after she claimed the goniopora cost under a hundred dollars. Amendment 12 shifts risk for the stabilizer software entirely onto the government — read section 4.3.2 before you initial anything. Attendance hit forty-two, a club record, mostly because the raffle included a protein skimmer donated by the sponsor. "Who signed off on the hull kit's weight waiver?" asked the staffer from Appropriations, not looking up from her binder. Old-timers cluster near the projector arguing photoperiods while the kids in the back trade zoas like baseball cards. Wasn't the suspension redesign supposed to be funded out of the contractor's own investment account? Someone's phone keeps buzzing during the alkalinity presentation, and the speaker finally pauses mid-sentence to glare. Six vendors bid on the sight upgrade; only one could actually deliver thermal optics at the quoted rate. I traded a golf-ball-sized hammer coral for two ricordea and still feel like I fleeced the poor kid. Off the record, the program manager conceded the armor recapitalization milestone would slip past the election. A teenager in a wetsuit-brand hoodie won the drawing for the doser and immediately asked what a doser was. Have the cost analysts reconciled the contractor's overhead rates with what the audit agency flagged last quarter? After the meeting adjourned, three members lingered to debate whether T5 bulbs still outgrow LEDs for sticks. Her notes from the briefing: turret drive, late; fire-control software, later; explanation, none. Nobody admitted to bringing the aiptasia-riddled rock that ended up on the freebie table. Every armored vehicle in the recapitalization plan needs a new powerpack, and the sole qualified supplier just raised prices eleven percent. He argued that dosing kalkwasser through a top-off pump beats two-part for small systems, and nobody at his table disagreed. The colonel flipped to slide fourteen, where the turret upgrade's unit cost had quietly grown from $1.2 million to $1.9 million. What is the meaning of the word tank?
